subject: Attendance alert: {count} absences recorded in {month_name}
body:
Hi {student_name},

Our records show that you have been marked absent {count} time(s) so far in {month_name} ({year_month}). This meets or exceeds the threshold of {threshold} absences in a month and has triggered an automatic attendance alert.

Recent absences:
{absence_list}

Upcoming exams in the affected module(s):
{upcoming_exams}

What to do next:
  1. If any of these absences were recorded in error, contact the module instructor straight away.
  2. If you had a valid reason and have not yet submitted a request, please log in to the Absence Tracker and submit one for each affected date.
  3. If you are struggling with attendance for any reason — health, personal circumstances, study workload — please reach out to your tutor or student support; they can help.

Continued unauthorised absence may affect your module results, your progression, and (for international students) your visa status. We would much rather hear from you early.

— Absence Tracker (automated)

variables.student_name: Student's display name (or student_id if missing)
variables.count: Number of absences in the calendar month
variables.absence_list: Multi-line bullet list of recent absences (date — module — status)
variables.upcoming_exams: Multi-line bullet list of exams in the affected modules with date >= today, or '(none scheduled)'
